omission.unit: one of the seven published Worker ID values, globally across all eleven selected stories
omission.membership: all seven identifiers bound by the identity_rows_sha256 file; sorted literal IDs; apply each to both fixed cohorts including explicit zero-effect states
omission.assignments: Assignment ID identifies a source annotation, not the global omission unit
omission.coverage: every selected story must have exactly three distinct nonempty Worker IDs initially and at least two complete six-axis ratings after each omission; never drop a story
omission.model_scores: unchanged exact five-repeat scalar means from the pinned 330-score floor preflight; six arms; original six-item and later five-item HBQ cohorts stay separate
omission.human_scalar: exact Fraction of summed six-axis integer ratings divided by six times surviving source rows
omission.statistic: Spearman with average ranks for exact ties; same omitted ID and unchanged item membership for every arm
omission.undefined: retain null correlation and null paired contrast when either arm is constant; do not replace, exclude or set to zero
omission.summary: baseline, all seven individual omission states, defined/undefined counts and descriptive min/max over defined states; affected-story and surviving-rating counts per state; paired comparator-minus-HBQ deltas

parent_target_check: reconstruct legacy nested statistics.fmean from source integer ratings and require exact equality to each frozen human_overall; exact Fraction converted to float must agree within 1e-12; this tolerance is provenance only, never tie arithmetic
target_ties: publish exact-versus-frozen-float pairwise tie/direction disagreements and both baseline target variants using the same fixed exact model means; not a literal legacy full-estimator replay
timing: retrospective source/identity refinement; prior scalar results and identity coverage are known; freeze before decoding these selected individual ratings or executing omission metrics
scope: only already-opened historical eleven-item development slice; decode six ratings plus identity only for those source IDs; route all other rows before rating decoding; skip prose, Prompt, Name and all contemporary target artifacts
interpretation: fixed-panel Worker-ID influence sensitivity; unequal annotation coverage affects influence; overlapping omission states are not independent replicates, a confidence interval, population reliability or a significance test; identifiers do not certify natural-person identities or credentials
